For extreme k, sign and derivative inequalities locate exactly two simple cubic roots inside the physically admissible branch-mode interval, while other regimes yield no sign-changing roots. Horizontal-intersection count gives one or two strict maxima and covers tangencies. The standalone stdlib verifier ran and passed exact discriminant rational checks, 1000 derivative comparisons, representative full modal tests and exact bimodal witness. Finite calculations supplement, not replace, the analytic universal argument.

value.rationale: A single impulse can produce two distinct downstream runoff peaks solely through storage-response heterogeneity. The theorem supplies exact global limits on rates for two peaks to be possible, and explicit necessary-and-sufficient mixing-weight thresholds rather than merely a finite numerical example. This models a meaningful mechanism distinct from storm-delay peak splitting, with a complete classification under natural minimal parallel Nash assumptions; the result has no empirical detectability claim.
